tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: List the evidence explorer, newsroom, API, feeds, MCP tools, audiences, and safety boundaries.

tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Return bounded headline aggregates across official prices, seizures, overdose mortality, wastewater, and public designations.

tools.name: get_newsroom
tools.description: List current deterministic analyses with citations, correction metadata, publication gates, and explicit evidence limits.

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: Fetch one story as metadata, a machine brief, or the cited dossier. Use the machine brief first for agent workflows.

tools.name: get_palimpsest_bridge
tools.description: Return the official-only China aggregate shared with the Intelligence Commons, including disclosure and causal boundaries.

tools.name: get_palimpsest_corridors
tools.description: Return official country-level China, Pakistan, and Myanmar aggregates with missing-data, provenance, disclosure, and geography-and-time-only join rules.

tools.name: get_palimpsest_bri_context
tools.description: Return pinned source readiness and national WDI coverage for CPEC, Gwadar, CMEC, Kyaukpyu, and Balochistan as a parallel context lane. Cross-lane drug, actor, route, guilt, political, project, causal, tactical, and navigable inference or use is prohibited.
